sources.name: abc-world
sources.description: ABC News (Australia): world news desk, as an RSS feed. (region: Australia / Asia-Pacific)

sources.name: aljazeera
sources.description: Al Jazeera: Qatar-based international news network, as an RSS feed. (region: Middle East)

sources.name: allafrica
sources.description: AllAfrica: pan-African news aggregator, as an RDF feed. (region: Africa)

sources.name: almonitor
sources.description: Al-Monitor: independent coverage and analysis of the Middle East, as an RSS feed. (region: Middle East)

sources.name: apollo
sources.description: Cambridge Apollo — Cambridge University institutional repository. Theses, working papers, preprints, and faculty research. DSpace REST API v7, no auth required.

sources.name: arabnews
sources.description: Arab News: Saudi Arabia-based English-language daily, as an RSS feed. (region: Middle East)

sources.name: archive
sources.description: Internet Archive — 41M+ texts, scanned books, historical documents.

sources.name: arxiv
sources.description: arXiv — 2M+ open access preprints: physics, math, CS, biology, economics, statistics. Full HTML text for most papers (2018+).

sources.name: attack
sources.description: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise: adversary tactics and techniques, downloaded once per process as a single STIX bundle and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API. No API key required.

sources.name: bhl
sources.description: Biodiversity Heritage Library — natural history, botany, zoology literature. Requires free BHL_API_KEY.

sources.name: biorxiv
sources.description: bioRxiv: biological sciences preprints. No API key required. bioRxiv has no free-text search API; search() lists the last 7 days of postings (paged, capped) and filters client-side by title/abstract match, so it can miss older matches or ones past the scan cap. Use read(doi) directly when you already have a DOI.

sources.name: bleepingcomputer
sources.description: BleepingComputer: computer security and technology news, as an RSS feed.

sources.name: bls
sources.description: BLS (Bureau of Labor Statistics) Public Data API v2: US labor and price statistics (unemployment, CPI, PPI, wages, productivity, JOLTS). No text search exists upstream; search() matches a bundled list of common series. Works keyless (conservative daily cap); set BLS_API_KEY for the registered 500/day tier.

sources.name: ccel
sources.description: Christian Classics Ethereal Library — patristics, Reformation theology, and Christian philosophy. Augustine, Aquinas, Calvin, Luther, Boethius, Origen, Edwards.

sources.name: census
sources.description: US Census Bureau dataset catalog: metadata for every dataset the Census Bureau API exposes (ACS, decennial census, economic surveys, and more). Downloaded once per process and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API. CENSUS_API_KEY is optional and not required for this catalog.

sources.name: cervantes
sources.description: Cervantes Virtual Library: Spanish and Portuguese literature. Search via the SPARQL linked-data catalog (data.cervantesvirtual.com); full text available for a small curated set of well-known works (Quijote, Lorca, Neruda, Borges, Rulfo, Calderón, San Juan de la Cruz).

sources.name: chroniclingamerica
sources.description: Chronicling America (LOC): full OCR text of US newspapers 1770-1963, now served via the unified loc.gov search/item API.

sources.name: circl
sources.description: CIRCL Vulnerability Lookup: full-text search across CVE, GHSA and other vulnerability feeds, run by Luxembourg's CERT. No API key required.

sources.name: cisco-psirt
sources.description: Cisco PSIRT: Cisco security advisories, as an RSS feed.

sources.name: codewiki
sources.description: Google Code Wiki — AI-generated continuously updated docs for any GitHub repo. Search indexed repos or fetch architecture overviews, API references, and class diagrams by passing "{owner}/{repo}". No auth required.

sources.name: coingecko
sources.description: CoinGecko: cryptocurrency search across thousands of coins and tokens, with a price/market-cap/description summary read. Works keyless; set COINGECKO_API_KEY for a higher rate limit.

sources.name: comtrade
sources.description: UN Comtrade: international merchandise trade statistics by HS (Harmonized System) commodity code. The query must be an HS code (e.g. "0101" or "010121"); any other query returns no results. Uses the keyless public preview endpoint by default.

sources.name: congress
sources.description: congress.gov API v3: US federal bill search and full text. There is no /v3/search endpoint and /v3/bill's q= parameter is ignored, so search() filters the most recently updated bills by title token. Shares the api.data.gov key family: reads DATA_GOV_API_KEY first, GOVINFO_API_KEY second.

sources.name: context7
sources.description: Context7: up-to-date library and framework documentation, indexed by library id (e.g. /reactjs/react.dev). Works keyless; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for a higher rate.

sources.name: context7mcp
sources.description: Context7 documentation search via its own MCP server (resolve-library-id then query-docs). Works keyless; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for a higher rate. Additive to the existing context7 REST source. read() cannot target a specific topic (query-docs needs one but read(id) carries no query), so it uses a generic default query; search() again with a specific topic for targeted docs.

sources.name: core
sources.description: CORE: 57M+ open access research papers with full text. Broadest OA academic aggregator across all disciplines. Requires free CORE_API_KEY.

sources.name: courtlistener
sources.description: CourtListener: US federal and state court opinions. Free Law Project. Requires free COURTLISTENER_API_KEY (125 req/day authenticated cap since 2026-05-07).

sources.name: crossref
sources.description: Crossref: authoritative DOI metadata for 160M+ scholarly records, including reference lists and a BibTeX citation. Works keyless; set CONTACT_EMAIL for the polite pool (higher rate limit).

sources.name: ctext
sources.description: Chinese Text Project: pre-Qin and Han dynasty classical Chinese texts with English translations. Full-text read requires a registered IP or optional CTEXT_API_KEY per ctext.org/tools/api; search stays keyless.

sources.name: cwe
sources.description: MITRE CWE: the Common Weakness Enumeration, a single-id weakness lookup (e.g. CWE-79 or 79); there is no keyword search endpoint, so any other query returns []. No API key required.

sources.name: dailymaverick
sources.description: Daily Maverick: South African news and investigative journalism, as an RSS feed. (region: Africa)

sources.name: datacite
sources.description: DataCite: DOI metadata for research datasets and software (Zenodo, Figshare, Dryad, OSF, and more all register here) - one source for the whole data-repository DOI tier. No API key required (3,000 req/5min/IP).

sources.name: datagov
sources.description: Data.gov — US government open data catalog. 300k+ datasets from federal, state, local, and tribal agencies. No key required. Metadata and discovery.

sources.name: dblp
sources.description: DBLP: venue-precise computer science bibliography search. No API key required. Keyless, paced at 1 request/second per dblp's own guidance.

sources.name: dbnomics
sources.description: DBnomics: an aggregator of macroeconomic and statistical datasets from central banks, statistical agencies, and international organizations worldwide. No API key required.

sources.name: depsdev
sources.description: deps.dev v3: package version metadata (licenses, dependency links, advisories) across npm, PyPI, cargo, Go, Maven and more. Query as system:name (e.g. npm:lodash); a bare name defaults to npm.

sources.name: devto
sources.description: DEV Community (dev.to) articles. A single-word query filters by tag; a multi-word query uses the site search endpoint, which returns no results for any query as of 2026-09-01 (an upstream issue, see the task report). No API key required.

sources.name: digitalnz
sources.description: DigitalNZ: New Zealand digital heritage including Māori and Pacific content. Keyless (rate-limited); set DIGITALNZ_API_KEY for a higher limit.

sources.name: doab
sources.description: Directory of Open Access Books — 70k+ peer-reviewed OA academic monographs across all disciplines. Metadata + external PDF links.

sources.name: doaj
sources.description: DOAJ — Directory of Open Access Journals. 12M+ peer-reviewed OA articles from 20,000+ journals. No API key required.

sources.name: dpla
sources.description: Digital Public Library of America: 17M+ items from US libraries, archives, and museums. Metadata aggregator. Requires free DPLA_API_KEY.

sources.name: dw
sources.description: Deutsche Welle: German public international broadcaster, as an RDF feed. (region: Europe)

sources.name: earlyprint
sources.description: EarlyPrint: 60,000+ Early Modern English texts (EEBO/ECCO/Evans TCP), 1473-1700. Linguistically annotated. BlackLab-indexed. Hidden: the eplab.artsci.wustl.edu BlackLab catalog is returning 404 as of 2026-09; re-enable once it returns.

sources.name: ecosystems
sources.description: Ecosyste.ms Packages: exact package name lookup across every open source package registry it indexes (npm, PyPI, crates.io, RubyGems, and more). Requires CONTACT_EMAIL (sent as a courteous User-Agent mailto).

sources.name: eia
sources.description: US Energy Information Administration (EIA) API v2: energy production, consumption, and pricing series. A dotted query (e.g. "PET.MCRFPUS2.M") looks up a series directly; otherwise search() filters EIA's route catalog by name (v2 has no keyword-search endpoint). Requires free EIA_API_KEY.

sources.name: epatri
sources.description: EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI): facility search by name, part of EPA's tracking of industrial toxic chemical releases. No API key required.

sources.name: epss
sources.description: FIRST.org EPSS: the Exploit Prediction Scoring System, a probability (0-1) that a CVE will be exploited in the next 30 days. Query as a single CVE id (e.g. CVE-2021-44228); anything else returns []. No API key required.

sources.name: eric
sources.description: ERIC — 2M+ education research documents from the US Dept of Education. No API key required.

sources.name: eurlex
sources.description: EUR-Lex (via the CELLAR SPARQL endpoint): EU treaties, regulations, directives, and national implementing measures, searchable by title keyword. No API key required.

sources.name: europeana
sources.description: Europeana — 50M+ cultural heritage items from European museums, libraries, and archives. Requires free EUROPEANA_API_KEY.

sources.name: europmc
sources.description: Europe PMC — 43M+ biomedical and life science literature. Full text for open access PMC articles.

sources.name: euvd
sources.description: EUVD: the European Union Vulnerability Database, ENISA's aggregation of CVE, GHSA and vendor advisories. No API key required.

sources.name: exploitdb
sources.description: Exploit-DB: public archive of exploits and vulnerable software, as an RSS feed.

sources.name: federalregister
sources.description: Federal Register: the daily journal of the US federal government (rules, proposed rules, and notices). No API key required.

sources.name: folha-en
sources.description: Folha de S.Paulo: English-language edition, as an RSS feed. (region: Latin America)

sources.name: france24
sources.description: France 24: French public international news channel, as an RSS feed. (region: Europe)

sources.name: frankfurter
sources.description: Frankfurter: free daily exchange rates from the European Central Bank. A query like "USD" or "USD EUR" looks up live rates; anything else searches currency names. No API key required.

sources.name: fred
sources.description: FRED: the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis's economic data API, hundreds of thousands of US and international time series. Requires free FRED_API_KEY.

sources.name: gallica
sources.description: Gallica/BnF — 5M+ digitized documents from the French national library. Full text available for OCR'd items.

sources.name: gdelt
sources.description: GDELT: the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone. Full-text search across worldwide news coverage monitored by GDELT. No API key required.

sources.name: ghsa
sources.description: GitHub Security Advisories: advisories curated by GitHub across public repositories and package ecosystems. Works keyless (60 req/h); set GITHUB_TOKEN for a higher rate.

sources.name: githubmcp
sources.description: GitHub code search via the official Copilot MCP server (search_code, get_file_contents). Requires GITHUB_TOKEN; hidden without it.

sources.name: githubsearch
sources.description: GitHub code search: full-text search across public repository contents. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN (the /search/code endpoint rejects unauthenticated requests).

sources.name: googlebooks
sources.description: Google Books: 40M+ books. Full text for public domain titles; preview snippets for in-copyright works. Requires free GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY (the shared keyless quota is exhausted).

sources.name: googlenews
sources.description: Google News: search-by-query RSS aggregator across global news sources.

sources.name: govinfo
sources.description: GovInfo: US Congressional Record, Federal Register, US Code, Bills, CFR, and more. GPO official archive. Requires free GOVINFO_API_KEY.

sources.name: guardian
sources.description: The Guardian Open Platform: full-text search across Guardian journalism, with article body text. Requires free GUARDIAN_API_KEY.

sources.name: gutenberg
sources.description: Project Gutenberg — 76k+ public domain books, best for pre-1928 literature.

sources.name: hal
sources.description: HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne): 4M+ full-text French/EU academic deposits with a Solr search across titles, abstracts, and full text. No API key required.

sources.name: hansard
sources.description: UK Parliament Hansard: full-text search over Commons and Lords debates, with the complete member-by-member record of any one debate. No API key required.

sources.name: hapi
sources.description: HDX HAPI (Humanitarian Data Exchange, Humanitarian API): conflict-event and coordination data. A country-name query resolves to a conflict-events lookup; other queries search HAPI's location metadata. Requires free HDX_APP_IDENTIFIER (self-serve).

sources.name: harvardlib
sources.description: Harvard LibraryCloud: 20M+ records from Harvard Libraries: books, archives, manuscripts, maps, photographs, theses. Public REST API, no key required. Hidden: api.lib.harvard.edu returns 429 from its load balancer for datacenter clients as of 2026-09; revisit.

sources.name: hfpapers
sources.description: Hugging Face Papers: a community-curated feed of arXiv papers with upvotes and discussion threads. No API key required. Full text is read via the arxiv source (every id is an arXiv id).

sources.name: hn
sources.description: Hacker News, via the Algolia HN Search API: stories and comments. No API key required.

sources.name: hud
sources.description: HUD Fair Market Rents (FMR): US rental cost benchmarks by area, used to set Section 8 voucher payment standards. The query must be a 5-digit ZIP code or a 2-letter state code; any other query returns no results. Requires a bearer HUD_API_TOKEN.

sources.name: huggingface
sources.description: Hugging Face Hub paper search via its MCP hf_fs tool (an hf://papers search). Full text is read via the arxiv source (every result id is a bare arXiv id). No API key required.

sources.name: ietf
sources.description: IETF Datatracker: RFC search by title, full text read from rfc-editor.org. No API key required.

sources.name: internetclassics
sources.description: Internet Classics Archive (MIT) — 440+ classical works in English translation.

sources.name: jina
sources.description: Jina AI's live web search and page reader MCP server (search_web, read_url). Works keyless for connecting; set JINA_API_KEY for actual search/read calls (unauthenticated calls return an error result). cluster web, freshness realtime.

sources.name: jinaarxiv
sources.description: Jina AI's search_arxiv tool: arXiv preprint search via the same MCP server as jina. Full text is read via the arxiv source when a result carries an arxiv_id. Works keyless for connecting; set JINA_API_KEY for actual search calls.

sources.name: jinasearch
sources.description: Jina AI Search (s.jina.ai): web search returning clean per-result text. Requires JINA_API_KEY; hidden without it to respect the 20 RPM anonymous cap shared across every caller. read() fetches and extracts the linked page.

sources.name: kev
sources.description: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: CVEs CISA has confirmed are being actively exploited. Downloaded once per process and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API.

sources.name: legislation
sources.description: legislation.gov.uk — UK Acts of Parliament, Statutory Instruments, and devolved legislation with time-aware full text. No API key required.

sources.name: legislationscot
sources.description: Scottish Parliament legislation — Acts of the Scottish Parliament (ASP) and Scottish Statutory Instruments (SSI). No API key required.

sources.name: lobsters
sources.description: Lobsters: a computing-focused link aggregation and discussion community, as an RSS feed.

sources.name: loc
sources.description: Library of Congress — US history, maps, newspapers, manuscripts. 170M+ items. Metadata and discovery.

sources.name: marxists
sources.description: Marxists Internet Archive — socialist, anarchist, and critical theory texts. Marx, Engels, Luxemburg, Gramsci, Fanon, Benjamin, and 700+ authors.

sources.name: mdn
sources.description: MDN Web Docs search: web platform reference and guides. No API key required.

sources.name: mdnmcp
sources.description: MDN Web Docs's own MCP server: web platform reference and guides, with full document text via get-doc. No API key required. Additive to the existing mdn REST source, which it falls back to when the MCP server is unreachable.

sources.name: medrxiv
sources.description: medRxiv: clinical and health sciences preprints. No API key required. medRxiv has no free-text search API; search() lists the last 7 days of postings (paged, capped) and filters client-side by title/abstract match, so it can miss older matches or ones past the scan cap. Use read(doi) directly when you already have a DOI.

sources.name: msrc
sources.description: Microsoft Security Response Center: Microsoft product security update guide, as an RSS feed.

sources.name: nara
sources.description: US National Archives (NARA): 32M+ descriptions of historical government records: war diaries, presidential papers, military records, federal agencies. Requires free NARA_API_KEY.

sources.name: nasa
sources.description: NASA NTRS — space science, aeronautics, and engineering technical reports. No API key required.

sources.name: nasaads
sources.description: NASA ADS — Astrophysics Data System. Premier portal for astronomy, astrophysics, and physics research. Requires NASA_ADS_API_KEY (free at ui.adsabs.harvard.edu).

sources.name: nbnorway
sources.description: National Library of Norway — digitized books, manuscripts, and newspapers with OCR text in JSON. No API key required.

sources.name: ndl
sources.description: Japan National Diet Library — 350k+ out-of-copyright digitized books. Metadata and discovery; full text via NDL Digital Collections.

sources.name: newsdata
sources.description: newsdata.io: real-time global news article search. Requires free NEWSDATA_API_KEY.

sources.name: nhk
sources.description: NHK World News: Japanese public broadcaster, English-language world news headlines.

sources.name: nih
sources.description: NIH RePORTER — National Institutes of Health funded research projects and abstracts. No API key required.

sources.name: nikkeiasia
sources.description: Nikkei Asia: business and economic news from Asia, as an RSS feed. (region: Asia)

sources.name: nist-csrc
sources.description: NIST Computer Security Resource Center: draft publications currently open for public comment, as an Atom feed.

sources.name: nsf
sources.description: NSF Awards — National Science Foundation research grants and abstracts across all scientific disciplines.

sources.name: nvd
sources.description: NIST NVD: the National Vulnerability Database, CVE records enriched with CVSS scores and CPE matches. Works keyless at a slow pace; set NVD_API_KEY for a faster one.

sources.name: openalex
sources.description: OpenAlex: 200M+ scholarly works. Free replacement for Scopus/Web of Science. Covers all disciplines. No API key required (set CONTACT_EMAIL for the polite pool, or OPENALEX_API_KEY for the paid tier).

sources.name: opencitations
sources.description: OpenCitations Index v2: an open citation graph. search(doi) returns citing works; read(doi) returns the outgoing reference list. No article text - not ingestible. Optional OPENCITATIONS_ACCESS_TOKEN for a higher rate limit.

sources.name: openfda
sources.description: openFDA drug enforcement reports: FDA drug recalls, searchable by product description. Works keyless; set OPENFDA_API_KEY for a higher rate limit.

sources.name: openiti
sources.description: OpenITI: 10,000+ Islamicate texts in Arabic and Persian (OpenITI mARkdown). Set GITHUB_TOKEN for full-corpus code search; without it, search falls back to a small set of per-century data repos (GitHub code search now requires auth even for public repos).

sources.name: openlibrary
sources.description: Open Library — 30M+ records. Metadata and discovery; links to Archive.org for text.

sources.name: ora
sources.description: Oxford ORA: Oxford University Research Archive. Oxford theses, preprints, working papers, and the Oxford Text Archive (classical texts, TEI/XML). No auth required.

sources.name: osf
sources.description: OSF Preprints — PsyArXiv, SocArXiv, EarthArXiv, engrXiv, and more via Open Science Framework. No API key required.

sources.name: osti
sources.description: DOE OSTI — Department of Energy research: nuclear, energy, physics, materials science. No API key required.

sources.name: osv
sources.description: OSV.dev: the Open Source Vulnerability database aggregating advisories from GitHub, PyPI, npm, RustSec and more. Query as a direct advisory id (CVE-/GHSA-/PYSEC-/RUSTSEC-/GO-prefixed) for one record, or as ecosystem:name (e.g. npm:lodash) for a package advisory list. No API key required.

sources.name: paperswithcode
sources.description: Papers with Code: machine learning papers cross-referenced with their code implementations. Queries the community mirror at paperswithcode.co (the original paperswithcode.com API was retired 2025-07-24). No API key required.

sources.name: peps
sources.description: Python Enhancement Proposals (PEPs): index of every PEP by number and title. Downloaded once per process and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API. No API key required.

sources.name: perseus
sources.description: Perseus Digital Library: classical Greek, Latin, and Arabic texts with translations, served via the Scaife reading environment.

sources.name: plos
sources.description: PLOS — Public Library of Science journals. 100% open access. Biology, medicine, genetics, computational biology. No API key required.

sources.name: projectruneberg
sources.description: Project Runeberg — Scandinavian literature and cultural heritage. Ibsen, Strindberg, Lagerlöf, Andersen, Kierkegaard.

sources.name: projectzero
sources.description: Google Project Zero: vulnerability research blog, as an Atom feed.

sources.name: pubmed
sources.description: PubMed (NCBI E-utilities): MeSH-aware biomedical literature search. read() returns PMC BioC full text when a PMCID exists, otherwise the PubMed abstract via efetch. Works keyless (3 rps); set NCBI_API_KEY for 10 rps.

sources.name: readthedocs
sources.description: Read the Docs: server-side search across hosted project documentation. Scope a query to one project with a "project:<slug>" prefix (e.g. "project:requests authentication") - an unscoped query returns nothing. No API key required for public projects.

sources.name: regulations
sources.description: Regulations.gov API v4: US federal rulemaking dockets and public comment documents. Shares the api.data.gov key family: reads DATA_GOV_API_KEY first, GOVINFO_API_KEY second.

sources.name: reliefweb
sources.description: ReliefWeb: humanitarian reports and situation updates from UN OCHA and partner organizations. Requires a registered RELIEFWEB_APPNAME.

sources.name: rentcast
sources.description: RentCast: US rental and sale market statistics by ZIP code. Requires free-tier RENTCAST_API_KEY (50 requests/month).

sources.name: restofworld
sources.description: Rest of World: technology news from the Global South, as an RSS feed. (region: Global South)

sources.name: sacredtexts
sources.description: Sacred-Texts.com: curated registry of religious/philosophical texts: Quran, Sufi corpus, Vedanta, Buddhism, Taoism, Hermeticism, Christian mysticism. The live site is bot-gated (HTTP 403); read() returns metadata only.

sources.name: scmp
sources.description: South China Morning Post: Hong Kong-based news covering China and Asia, as an RSS feed. (region: East Asia)

sources.name: searxng
sources.description: SearXNG: a self-hosted, privacy-respecting metasearch engine aggregating results across many upstream search engines. Requires SEARXNG_URL (a deployment-specific instance URL); hidden without it. read() fetches and extracts the linked page.

sources.name: secedgar
sources.description: SEC EDGAR full-text search: US public company filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more) since 2001. Requires CONTACT_EMAIL for the mandatory identifying User-Agent (SEC 403s unidentified requests); 10 rps hard cap.

sources.name: semanticscholar
sources.description: Semantic Scholar: 200M+ academic papers. Abstracts always available; OA PDF links for open access papers. Supports library_recommend. Set SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY for a dedicated rate pool.

sources.name: smithsonian
sources.description: Smithsonian Institution — 14M+ records across all museums: American history, air & space, natural history, art, military artifacts. Requires SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY (free at api.data.gov).

sources.name: springer
sources.description: Springer Nature — 16M+ articles via Meta API (all content, abstracts) + OA API (open access full text). Requires SPRINGER_META_API_KEY and SPRINGER_OA_API_KEY (free at dev.springernature.com).

sources.name: stackexchange
sources.description: Stack Overflow (via the Stack Exchange API): advanced full-text question search. Works keyless at the shared rate limit; set STACKEXCHANGE_KEY for a dedicated pool.

sources.name: standardebooks
sources.description: Standard Ebooks — carefully typeset and proofread public domain ebooks.

sources.name: swiftevolution
sources.description: Swift Evolution proposals: every accepted, rejected, or in-review Swift language proposal with its status. Downloaded once per process and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API. No API key required.

sources.name: tavily
sources.description: Tavily: a web search API purpose-built for LLM agents and RAG pipelines, with results pre-summarized for relevance. Requires TAVILY_API_KEY; hidden without it. read() fetches and extracts the linked page.

sources.name: tc39
sources.description: TC39 (ECMAScript) proposals: every JavaScript language proposal with its current stage. Downloaded once per process and filtered client-side; there is no per-query search API. No API key required.

sources.name: thediplomat
sources.description: The Diplomat: current affairs magazine covering the Asia-Pacific, as an RSS feed. (region: Asia-Pacific)

sources.name: thehindu-intl
sources.description: The Hindu: international news desk of the Indian daily, as an RSS feed. (region: South Asia)

sources.name: trove
sources.description: Trove (NLA Australia): 340M+ items from Australian libraries, newspapers, archives. Requires free TROVE_API_KEY. Full text is fetched only for newspaper articles that carry a fulltext link; other categories stay metadata-only. Governed by an NLA data agreement: live calls only, no storage, capped full-text reads per session.

sources.name: twelvedata
sources.description: Twelve Data: stock, ETF, and forex symbol search across global exchanges, with a daily time series read. Requires free TWELVEDATA_API_KEY.

sources.name: ucdp
sources.description: UCDP (Uppsala Conflict Data Program) Georeferenced Event Dataset: individually coded events of organized violence, searchable by country. Requires free UCDP_TOKEN.

sources.name: ukparliament
sources.description: UK Parliament Bills API: public legislation before the House of Commons and House of Lords. No API key required.

sources.name: w3c
sources.description: W3C specifications: the first 1000 (of the full catalog), downloaded once per process and filtered client-side by title, since the upstream API ignores its own q= search parameter. No API key required.

sources.name: wdl
sources.description: World Digital Library (via LOC) — 19k+ rare and unique cultural heritage items from 200 countries, 8000 BCE–present. Maps, manuscripts, photographs, films, sound recordings.

sources.name: webfetch
sources.description: Direct web fetch: search() always returns []; read(id=<url>) fetches and extracts the text of any http(s) page via the fetch tier (defuddle, then jina, then crawl4ai, then Browser Run, whichever is configured). Use this to read a URL surfaced by another source, or any URL the caller already has.

sources.name: wikicurrent
sources.description: Wikipedia Portal:Current events: the collaboratively edited daily log of world news, parsed from the portal's rendered HTML. No API key required.

sources.name: wikidata
sources.description: Wikidata: entity search (wbsearchentities) across 100M+ structured knowledge-base items. Entity search only, no full-text read - use library_read for the entity page URL. Works keyless; set CONTACT_EMAIL for a compliant contact User-Agent.

sources.name: wikipedia
sources.description: Wikipedia (English): full-text page search plus full article read (summary + mobile-html extraction). CC BY-SA text: attribution is a license condition, not optional. Works keyless; set CONTACT_EMAIL for a compliant contact User-Agent.

sources.name: wikisource
sources.description: Wikisource — multilingual library of free-content source texts in 70+ languages.

sources.name: worldbank
sources.description: World Bank Indicators API v2: 29.5k+ development indicators (GDP, poverty, health, education, and more) across every country. No server-side search - search() filters the full indicator catalog client-side by name/description match. No API key required.

sources.name: youtube
sources.description: YouTube: video search via the official Data API v3 (requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY, ~100 searches/day). Transcripts prefer Supadata (SUPADATA_API_KEY, a maintained third-party transcript service) when configured; otherwise fall back to an undocumented endpoint since no official transcript API exists for third-party videos, same risk profile as codewiki (can break without notice, ToS gray area for automated access; low-volume personal/research use only). No ingest: transcripts stay read-only, never indexed.

sources.name: zenodo
sources.description: Zenodo — CERN open repository: papers, datasets, software. 2M+ records across all disciplines.
